newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle up, still in recent range.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle up, still in recent range.

text.p: NYCE Frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed firmer on mixed technically-driven buying, but prices remained entrenched within their recent trading range, floor sources said.

Speculative buying took out stops around 106.00 in November in early dealings, but local selling capped gains. Light trade scale-up buying and speculative buying that emerged in the afternoon carried the contract to the day's high.
Resistance was maintained between 110.00 and 112.00 and support at 103.00 basis the most-active November contract.
November FCOJ settled 3.35 cent a lb firmer at 108.15, having ranged from 108.25 to 104.80. The remaining months closed up 2.70.
Volume was estimated at a slim 1,500 lots.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture will release its next estimate for the Florida crop in October. Expectations put the crop around 215 million 90-lb boxes.
